ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - New colony
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A Pickle step that starts a NEW colony from the main menu: scenario, storyteller, difficulty, map size and seed fixed, then the game's own generation of the world, the map and the colonists, up to a playable, paused map. Optional developer tooling: no Defs, no features, nothing runs unless a scenario asks for it. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See NewColony/README.md at the repository root.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
